**Repaired finding submitted: T4C — missing (preferred target).**

Changes made in response to the verifier:

1. **Pro-rata refund now in operative language.** The new 9.4 adds "…in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro-rata basis, all prepaid Fees covering the period after the effective date of termination," using the defined term *Fees* (1.5) so prepaid professional services and usage Fees are captured, not just the narrower "recurring Fees" of retained 10.2. Element coverage no longer relies on 10.2 as already_met.
2. **Numbering fixed.** The inserted paragraph is labelled "9.4" in the text, matching the document's convention (e.g. "9.3 Customer may terminate…") and filling the gap between 9.3 and 9.5.
3. **Level.** Preferred retained; fallback is unavailable because 30 days' notice falls outside the 60–90 day band.
4. **Minimality preserved.** Still one insertion, two sentences, no deletions; "in whole or in part," survival, expense and procedural tails omitted; 9.1–9.3, 9.5 and 10.2 untouched.
